## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and notices changes in the community during Sunday church, including the marriage of [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) and news that [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) is terminally ill. The next evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visit [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md) to drop off jelly before going to see Ruby. At the Gillis home, Ruby tries to maintain a lively facade about her social life and future plans despite her deteriorating health.
